scope: Repository-visibility question and team discussion only. No product/README/WORK_LOG edit, Git stage/commit/push/history rewrite, account mutation, repository creation/public conversion, Pages setup, deployment, browser or product-test execution.
currentConclusion: Technically yes: making the existing repository PUBLIC and enabling its GitHub Pages is a simple free path when code/examples/docs/research and Git history are intended to be public. Publication visibility and Pages deployment are separate actions.

intentDistinction.wholeToolAndResearch: Existing PUBLIC repository plus its Pages; no standalone packager/note removal/viewer is mandatory when all sample data and research are intentionally public.
intentDistinction.presentationOnly: PRIVATE authoring repository plus a selected PUBLIC artifact repository remains a narrower option; not the only technically valid choice.

checks.noteClassification: Fictional sample, authoring/composition/source/credit guidance; notes field presence is not a finding of confidential content.

independentCredentialShapeCheck.limits: Not a complete secrets audit; no credential values printed.

collaboration.initialPosition: deployment_engineer: whole-tool disclosure allows simpler existing-repository Pages operation.
collaboration.objection: product_workflow_engineer: sharing a presentation URL does not imply disclosing all 383 files/research/work logs and 10 commits.
collaboration.resolution: Both read drafts and separated whole-tool disclosure from presentation-only publication; Pages artifact selection does not hide a PUBLIC Git repository.

collaboration.initialPosition: deployment_engineer questioned whether notes, missing license, or unconfirmed research reuse permission are technical blockers.
collaboration.resolution: product_workflow_engineer read all 62 sample notes, distinguished fictional guidance from secret data, and agreed public visibility/Pages do not require a license file, note stripping or a packager. Third-party redistribution rights remain a documented scope limit, not a legal prohibition finding.

limits: Actual permission to change visibility and actual Pages settings/deployment were not tested.
129 references were resolved against the proposed project URL and current local files; this is not browser/CDN validation.
Research credits/source provenance were reviewed; blanket redistribution permission for every archived third-party photo/frame/webpage was not established or legally ruled out.
Future personal confidential drafts/notes should not be committed to an intentionally PUBLIC tool repository.
